purpose: Verify that the numerical gate accepts an independent shared-bias column, rejects exact clock/position confounding, and recovers noise-free injected biases.

real_track_membership_projection.interpretation: A constant receiver bias is exactly in the span of per-track offsets. A receiver-shared linear drift adds geometry beyond those offsets, but still requires the unavailable position/nuisance Jacobian and independent physical bounds.

interpretation: The implementation detects the intended algebraic failure. The real membership projection establishes only offset-column independence, not full DS7 drift identifiability or calibration.
